name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: New roof installations typically come with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty on the roofing materials and a contractor's warranty on the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20 years to lifetime, depending on the material. Workmanship warranties vary by contractor but commonly last from 5 to 10 years. Always clarify the specifics of both warranties before starting your project to understand your coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a manufacturer's warranty on materials (20 years to lifetime) and a contractor's warranty on workmanship (typically 5-10 years).
